name: Comic
tagline: Stick-figure comic strips that explain a concept, lettered by hand and drawn on the GPU.

fields.name: brief
fields.note: what to explain and the angle to take: the concept, who is confused by it, where the joke is; the ask when left out

fields.name: panels
fields.note: how many panels, 1 to 6; left out, the model picks three to five, or one for a gag

fields.name: script
fields.note: a strip's PNG from an earlier call (it carries its script), or a .comic.json, to draw again; with a brief, changed as the brief asks

fields.name: output
fields.note: where to write the PNG; comics/<title>.png when left out

fields.name: rounds
fields.note: how many times the model may fix what the strip measured; 3 when left out

fields.name: seed
fields.note: a number that fixes the hand's wobble; the same script and seed draw the same picture

fields.name: renderer
fields.note: gpu, cpu, or auto (left out): the GPU when there is one, the same picture on the CPU when there is none
